provider.description: the platform operating the endpoint. 'other' for providers outside the ten named ones; name the actual provider in the record name/notes (e.g. novita, nebius, hyperbolic).

endpoint_url.description: base URL of the OpenAI-compatible (or native) API endpoint, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

models_served.description: bare model record ids (slugs from data/models/) this service can serve. Where the provider spells the id differently (llama-3.3-70b-versatile, anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5), record the provider spelling in notes, not here - this field is a cross-reference and unresolved entries are counted as dangling references. A sample, not a census.

price_input_per_mtok_usd.description: USD per 1M input tokens, list price for ONE representative model named in price_basis. Never the cheapest headline figure unless the basis says so.

price_output_per_mtok_usd.description: USD per 1M output tokens for the same representative model as price_input_per_mtok_usd.

price_basis.description: MANDATORY even when both price fields are null: which model/tier/region the prices are for, when observed, and why the numbers are what they are (single-model list price, catalog range, sales-gated catalog). A price with no basis is noise.

context_window.description: max context tokens for the representative model as the provider exposes it. Per-model in reality; the basis says which model.

measured_ttft_ms.description: measured time to first token in milliseconds for the representative model; third-party median (artificial-analysis, llmperf) preferred over vendor claims. null = not measured here.

measured_tps.description: measured output tokens per second (single-stream decode) for the representative model. Same provenance rule as measured_ttft_ms; measurement_source says who measured.

measurement_source.description: who produced measured_ttft_ms / measured_tps. vendor = provider-published number (e.g. Groq prints tok/s on its model page); null = no measurement recorded. Required whenever a measured_* field is set.

regions.description: regions where inference is actually served or offered: cloud region names (us-east-1, eu-west-1), or coarse scope (us, eu, apac, global) when the provider does not expose a region choice.

sources.description: source ids; each must exist in data/sources/
